versions.name: Static Orb Scale
versions.description: Disables orb pulse and allows to set their scale

about:
# Static Orb Scale
###### requested by [WDWiktor](user:10929123)

This mod disables <cd>pulses</c> <cl>*just*</c> for <cc>orbs</c>. It also allows you to <cf>customize their final scale</c> in <cs>**mod settings**</c>

Note that this mod is <ca>purely visual</c> and does <cr>not</c> change hitboxes

Most of the time the scale selected in <cs>settings</c> will <cg>still work</c> with global `No Pulse` mods that apply to <co>all objects</c>, such as hacks from <cl>mod menus</c>
